title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Your scouting director made a sensible statement on the possibility of drafting Oregon State's Luke Heimlich. Perhaps a strong one, some would say. One that would be applauded by the vast majority of your fan base.
And then, curiously, that question was not included on the "official transcript" of the conference call
Could barely hear you on the call. Were you driving with the top down? Glad you could hear his response.
And now I have to write about the curious disappearance of that question

You have his response, write it if that is your focus. How about thanks for getting him and the player on the phone at midnight. Or for providing quotes immediately following the pick (s). You’re welcome.
I already got the player. It's the no. 1 pick in the draft, you guys should be bending over backwards to have guys talk about it. But thank you.
But if the Detroit Tigers, a charter member of the American League, is to provide an "official transcript," I just think it should be an "official transcript"
For the record, I have asked to have your last question included, and resent to our local media group.
Thank you for hearing me out. Pleis answered the question great, I felt, which should be the sole focus of the story
I did not know it was omitted. It was not requested to be. It was hard to hear you on the call.
Yeah I was driving back to Atlanta, sorry
